mapper.select: SELECT o.id, o.task_id, o.publisher_id, o.acceptor_id, o.reward_amount, o.status, o.submit_content, o.submit_images AS submitImagesJson, o.reject_reason, o.applied_at, o.approved_at, o.submitted_at, o.completed_at, o.created_at FROM trade_order o WHERE o.id = #{orderId} AND o.deleted = 0
